gpu_mode: swangle_indirect (ANGLE on SwiftShader Vulkan, software), headless -no-window; P08 only
phases: primary (counters, slices, memory, startup) first, frames (FrameTimingMetric) last
bench_lock: exclusive flock per measured block (one am-instrument call)
exclusion_rule: iteration dropped if host MemAvailable < 1024 MB at iteration start or swap-in during it (criterion 'emulator': 'system' = host pswpin > 0, 'emulator' = qemu process major faults > 0; both logged in iterlog.csv); extra rounds up to --max-extra
note: P08 window only. The default swiftshader_indirect makes the emulator process crash on the P08 corpus A (ports/a10-crash-check). Every other factor used swiftshader_indirect (environment.json).
hold_protocol: bench.lock (exclusive per block) + 3S-study-work/bench.hold (pid) for the whole window; 120 s yield after every factor group
